description: Capability for the main window on iOS and Android. Same file-access stance as the desktop capability (the webview gets no filesystem access to the app data dir; attachments arrive through the moony-file scheme), plus the phone hardware plugins: haptics, local notifications, and the in-repo keychain behind biometric unlock (its default set grants status and the privacy screen only; the stored DB key stays on the Rust side). The one exception to the file stance is a single staged text file: the recovery key is written to $DOCUMENT/moony-recovery-key.txt and removed again, because the iOS export picker can only export a file that already sits in Documents (backup archives are staged by Rust commands, so no zip scope is needed). No updater and no process plugin: the app stores ship updates.
